svg.title: Runtime workload protocol
svg.desc: The 24-hour release requirement was removed at the user’s explicit request on 2026-10-23. No 24-hour run is required for this delivery, and this release makes no 24-hour stability claim. bench/soak.py remains an optional diagnostic tool. The optional runner accepts at most 86400 seconds, validates the candidate hash on each cycle, performs all four task types plus repeated tab creation/closure, records actual PID/heartbeat/health/process samples, and cleans up on completion, interruption or failure. A short smoke run proves plumbing only. final.json must establish 24-hour duration, zero failures, successful cleanup and a post-warmup resource plateau before claiming long-run stability. No 24-hour soak was launched. A bounded smoke run can verify this optional tool’s plumbing; it does not establish long-duration stability.
